text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry I'm late...! I ended up 
forgetting a book...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Take it easy, take it easy. There's a step 
here, so don't rush getting on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Um, so that makes... one, two, three—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone's here! Driver, we're 
ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's get on board already too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the intense summer training camp 
came to an end!
